scientific_role: Attach one fixed development lifecycle to every immutable V36 price-delay event after the complete outcome-blind chart ledger was frozen. This is a mother-signal economic screen, not a portfolio replay, rule search, or validation.
economic_horizon_rationale: The predictor asks whether four already-observed weekly broad-market returns were incorporated with delay. A fixed 20-session lifecycle is the closest simple one-month response horizon; a +10% target and 40 bp round-trip cost reuse the established mother-screen execution convention rather than optimizing V36 outcomes.

signal_scope.signal_time: the exact completed month-end signal-session close recorded in each immutable candidate decision_at

outcome_data.maximum_event_path: 126 global market sessions strictly after each frozen signal, additionally capped at 2021-09-30
outcome_data.2021_role: Path-completion buffer for late-2020 frozen signals only; no 2021 signal or candidate may enter.
outcome_data.path_completeness: The cap must provide at least 126 global sessions after the latest signal. A candidate with no post-signal path rows fails closed rather than being mislabeled NO_LEGAL_ENTRY; incomplete sellability remains an explicit non-completed outcome.

outcome_attachment.entry: Inspect global market sessions signal+1 through signal+3 in order. Fill at the first legal, fully valid, non-upper-limit coordinate open. Never fill on the signal bar.
outcome_attachment.target: The first later same-lineage legal coordinate high at least 1.10 times entry exits at exactly +10% gross, subject to the frozen sellability check.
outcome_attachment.fallback: At the first same-lineage row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry_cal_idx+20, process the open before same-day high. Exit at target if sellable open is at or above target; otherwise exit at coordinate open. Only an unsellable open may defer to a later same-day legal target touch.

development_gate.if_failed: Keep 2022-2024 closed. Still render and manually inspect every development outcome chart under a separately frozen authorization, because full visual anatomy can determine whether one simple causal subset deserves a single frozen retry.
development_gate.if_passed: Still require complete outcome-chart review and one separately frozen causal rule before any 2022-2024 opening.

outputs.publication: same-parent temporary construction, complete audits, re-hash every bound input, then one atomic no-overwrite rename

prohibited: changing the delay definition, high-delay direction, event family, cooldown, boards, signal dates, candidate membership, or annual cohort
same-bar entry, entry after signal+3, target/horizon/cost search, stop search, or alternate execution
2021 signals, any row after 2021-09-30, or any 2022-2024 read
reading or grouping the frozen manual labels under Stage B
chart-rule construction, rule compression, portfolio replay, threshold rescue, market-state filter, or strategy combination
